description: This Dart source file defines the core synchronization engine for a note-taking app, managing sync states, handling push/pull of notes, handling errors, and managing retries based on connectivity and failures.

classes.name: SyncEngineState
classes.description: Represents the current state of the synchronization engine, including its status, last message, and last completion timestamp.

classes.name: SyncEngine
classes.description: Manages the synchronization process for notes, handling push and pull, managing sync status, errors, retries, and connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: SyncEngine.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current SyncEngineState with optional updated fields.

methods.name: SyncEngine.dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as timers and stream controllers.

methods.name: SyncEngine.syncNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate synchronization, handling push and pull of notes, error handling, and retry scheduling.

methods.name: SyncEngine._scheduleRetryIfOnline
methods.description: Schedules a retry of syncNow based on exponential backoff, if the device is online.

methods.name: SyncEngine._emit
methods.description: Updates the current state and notifies observers via the state stream.
